VBO:0201227.summary: Affectionate after a cautious start, Patricia gives a firsthand glimpse of the Shinese, a Pekingese–Shih Tzu cross. Her foster describes her becoming attached after a few days, beginning to play with the household’s small dogs, and sleeping quietly in her pen. She still avoids strangers and sometimes pauses nervously while learning to walk on a leash. She entered rescue from an Alabama hoarding case.
VBO:0201227.shortDescription: A Pekingese–Shih Tzu cross; adult Patricia’s foster records affection after settling in, quiet pen rests and cautious walks.

sources.title: Fetch Wisconsin Rescue — Patricia, own adult Pekingese–Shih Tzu cross foster account
sources.evidence: Entire actual original foster body read. Literal Pekingese x Shih Tzu Mix female12lb, shelterestimated6years; foster thinks somewhat younger and explicitly out of puppy phase. Initially shy, affectionate/attached after a few days; starting play with resident small dogs; sleeps quietly in pen while foster away/night. Avoids strangers, sometimes barks. Learning leash walking, sometimes scared/stops and gently coached. Came from Alabama hoarding case. Exact numeric age and image timestamps unknown; headline age estimate not proven photoage. Source safety/suitability/collar/adoption advice and health implications excluded; no parent-trait averaging. Source own cross identification retained without DNA/pedigree certainty.
